deploy-bot: [START] Multi-service fanout deploy initiated by @maria
Environment: production
Services:
 - runtime @redwood/runtime: v2.3.1 (commit abc1234)
 - api     @redwood/api:     v1.9.0 (commit def5678)
 - console @redwood/console: v0.8.4 (commit ghi9012)
Strategy: staged fanout (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%), stagger 2m between steps
Change window: 2026-03-20 09:00-11:00 UTC
Release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/2026-03-20
Deploy ID: deploy/2026-03-20-173
Will post status updates here.

maria: launching, pls watch metrics. I'll be on pager. :rocket:

aj: ack. watching LB + error rates. run-id #run-782

sre-bot: [HEALTHCHECK STREAM] 09:12 UTC -> runtime canary OK (p95 48ms), api canary OK (p95 60ms), console canary FAILED (5xx rate 2.6% vs baseline 0.4%) — failing endpoint: POST /session/create
Link: https://monitoring.example.com/incidents/456

leo: console spike looks like template rendering NPE in the stack. quick log snippet:
```
ERROR RuntimeException: template.render null
 at com.redwood.console.Templater.render(Templater.java:88)
 ...
```

maria: hold console rollout, do NOT advance to 25%. pin console to previous stable for prod. Can we rollback console to v0.8.3? that was last prod.
Also proceed with runtime and api rollout as planned.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Aborting further console canary steps. Initiating rollback for console -> v0.8.3 (tag v0.8.3-prev, commit xyz444)
Command: `redwoodctl deploy rollback console --to v0.8.3 --env prod --deploy-id deploy/2026-03-20-173`

nina: copying — kicking off rollback now.

aj: runtime and api continue. advancing runtime to 25% canary.

sre-bot: 09:18 UTC -> console rollback completed on canary cluster. 5xx rate returned to 0.35% (within baseline).
deploy-bot: console rollback finished — status: SUCCESS
runtime: advanced to 25% at 09:19 UTC, metrics holding
api: advanced to 100% at 09:21 UTC, metrics normal

maria: thanks team. i'll open a quick bug for console root cause and block re-rollout until patch merged.

leo: created issue #789: "console NPE in template.render" — added logs, suspect null template ref when user metadata missing.

aj: pinning console deployment to v0.8.3 in release config to prevent auto-roll forward during remainder of window.
Command: `redwoodctl pin console --version v0.8.3 --env prod --until 2026-03-25`

deploy-bot: All done. Summary: runtime v2.3.1 -> rolled out to 25% canary (holding), api v1.9.0 -> rolled out to 100%, console rollback to v0.8.3 -> SUCCESS and pinned.
Closing thread — reach out if any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
